# Theme Package Guidelines

## Component Reference
- `COMPONENTS.md` documents every public widget/API this package exports (constructors, params, usage). Read it before consuming this library, and update it whenever a public widget is added, renamed, or has its API changed.

## Theme Changes
- Any changes related to the theme must be made in the `lib/` directory.

## Running & Testing
- Use the `example/lib/main.dart` file and the `example` app to run, test, or preview the theme.
